Mike H: kicking off today's deploy window — canary roll to 10% now. please watch p95/p99 and 5xx. pin version=release-2026-03-21-2
DeployBot: Deploy started: canary -> 10% on prod. job id: deploy/57891
Sara L: seeing p95 latency uptick on embeddings route ~120ms -> baseline 70ms. looks like kvcache miss storm :grimacing: 
Elaine K: thanks @Sara L — what's the error rate on that route? can we reroute traffic off that model pool? :eyes: 
Tim O: alert fired: SLO > 2x baseline 5xx count in eu-west. link: https://dashboard.redwood/slo/embeds
Mike H: hold traffic increase. pin to previous variant `release-2026-03-20-9` for embeds. rollback command: `/deploy bot rollback --service embeds --to release-2026-03-20-9`
DeployBot: Acknowledged. Initiating partial pin on route=embeds, target=prev-variant. ETA ~45s
OpsPager: Incident created: INC-20260321-embeds-kv-miss. paging oncall.
Sara L: after pin p95 back to ~80ms. still some 429s but 5xx trending down. good to continue slow ramp? :thumbsup:
Elaine K: recommend hold at 10% for 15m, monitor prefix cache fill. I'll run a quick KV metrics query:
```
select count(*) from kvcache.misses where route='embeds' and ts > now() - 5m
```
Tim O: logs show GC spikes on GPU host g4-12-3 around deploy time, might be model load thrash. tagging infra.
Mike H: ok hold for 15m. if 5xx < 0.5% and p95 < 120ms then proceed to 50%. otherwise rollback fully. will update release notes and mark window.
Sara L: noted, will keep dashboard pinned and post updates every 5m.
DeployBot: Canary at 10% (pinned), next action: await manual signal.
